Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going to the store with her mommy to buy some candy. One day, her mommy told her about the store that she was going to buy some candy. Lily was excited because she loved candy!

At the store, Lily saw a big red candy on the ground. It looked like candy, but her mommy was happy because she knew the money would come with. So, her mommy asked the store how much it was, and Lily thought it looked yummy. She asked her mommy if she could have the same candy. Her mommy said yes
